title: Porch, verandah or unenclosed balcony projection into the primary street setback
text: C3.3.2 Notwithstanding C3.3.1, the following reductions are permitted: ii. for a porch, verandah, unenclosed balcony or equivalent the primary street setback may be reduced up to half the required primary street setback as specified in Table 3.3a, up to the full building width (refer Figure 3.3b); and
notes: from: ch3 C3.3.2(ii). Twice the porch, verandah or unenclosed balcony projection must not exceed the Table 3.3a primary setback (a formula whose value is the table lookup), i.e. at most half the required setback, up to the full building width (Figure 3.3b).
